summary: Le Nid keeps the information you give it (your name and email, your progress and to-dos, and your emergency contact) so the leaders can run the trip and look after you. Only leaders can see your emergency contact, any medical notes and your uploaded documents. Nothing is public. It is all deleted after the trip, and you can ask a leader to show you or delete your data at any time.
collect:
We keep:
- Your name and email.
- Your XP and lesson progress.
- Your to-do status and any documents you upload (for example a passport copy).
- Your emergency contact and, only if you choose to add them, medical notes.
- Your notification settings.
- When you use Translate or the voice button, the text or short audio you send. We do not store it. It is passed to the services listed under "Other services that handle your data".
You can leave the emergency fields empty, but we strongly recommend adding an emergency contact.
why:
- To run the trip: to-dos, schedule changes, reminders and the group goal.
- To look after you: if something goes wrong, your leaders can reach your emergency contact and know about allergies or medicines.
- To make Translate and the French voice practice work.
who:
- You can see your own information.
- Other members see only your name, team and leaderboard XP (and only if you chose to be on the leaderboard).
- Leaders (admins) can see your email, to-do progress, uploaded documents, emergency contact and medical notes. We keep a log of when a leader exports or opens the roster.
- Nobody outside the group can see it. Nothing is public.
third:
- Supabase: our database and file storage. Your data is stored in [REGION: leaders fill this in, for example EU (Frankfurt)].
- Vercel: hosts the app.
- Groq: turns your voice into text when you use speech input.
- DeepL: translates the text you type or speak.
- [EMAIL PROVIDER: leaders fill this in]: sends sign-in codes and the weekly summary email.
- Apple's push service: delivers the notifications you turned on.
retention: We delete your data (uploads, emergency contact, medical notes, progress and account) by [DELETION DATE: 30 days after we return]. Backups can keep a copy for a few more days. If you leave the group sooner, ask a leader and we will delete it sooner.
rights: You can ask a leader at any time to show you what we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it. Deleting your account removes your uploaded files too. You can also change or clear your own emergency info on the Me page whenever you like.
contact: Ask any leader, or contact [CONTACT: leaders fill in a name and a phone or email].
